lines.text: It's New Year's Eve, and Gerald has a resolution. No more shopping. For real this time.
He even made a sign, so everyone would know.
The countdown began. Three. Two. One!
Happy New Year! Fireworks lit up the sky.
Then, his phone buzzed. New Year sale. Seventy percent off.
Gerald's resolution lasted exactly four seconds.
Happy New Year, Gerald. Some things never change.
